dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent O-shaped structures exhibit a sharp gradient transition from a dark-brown exterior to a high-intensity cream-colored perimeter ring, which encloses a dark-brown interior core. The edges of the cream rings are jagged and irregular at the pixel level, particularly on the anterior-facing segments.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid, high-intensity light-colored clusters is observed along the lower-lateral boundary and the anterior dorsal region. These clusters lack an internal gradient or darker core, appearing as amorphous patches of concentrated high-intensity pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli located on the mid-dorsal flank form an irregular quadrilateral. The distance between the centroids of the two most posterior annuli is approximately 1.5 times the diameter of the largest annulus.
